instructions.zh: 在教师确认安全的平地，用软球与伙伴练习朝两个标记之间轻轻滚传。先确认对方准备，再各试三次；高年级可在教师许可下比较两个距离。
instructions.bm: Di permukaan rata yang disahkan selamat, golek bola lembut perlahan melalui dua penanda kepada rakan. Pastikan penerima bersedia dan cuba tiga kali; murid lebih tinggi boleh membandingkan dua jarak dengan izin guru.
instructions.en: On a teacher-approved level surface, gently roll a soft ball between two markers to a partner. Confirm readiness and try three times each; older pupils may compare two distances with teacher approval.

instructions.zh: 记录球从目标左、右或中间通过。只调整一次出手方向，再比较结果。
instructions.bm: Catat sama ada bola melalui kiri, kanan atau tengah sasaran. Laraskan arah pelepasan sekali dan bandingkan hasil.
instructions.en: Record whether the ball passes left, right or through the target. Adjust release direction once and compare the result.

successCriteria.zh: 出手前确认伙伴准备，动作朝指定目标完成。
successCriteria.bm: Pastikan rakan bersedia dan arahkan gerakan ke sasaran.
successCriteria.en: Check partner readiness and direct the action towards the target.

successCriteria.zh: 比较三次尝试，指出一个动作提示和一次调整。
successCriteria.bm: Bandingkan tiga percubaan dan nyatakan petunjuk serta pelarasan.
successCriteria.en: Compare three attempts and identify one movement cue and adjustment.

instructions.zh: 跟随教师的八拍安全步伐组合；先单独保持拍子，再与伙伴协调起止，不加入未教的高难动作。
instructions.bm: Ikuti rangkaian langkah selamat lapan detik daripada guru; kekalkan detik sendiri lalu selaraskan mula/tamat dengan rakan.
instructions.en: Follow a safe eight-count step sequence taught by the teacher; keep the pulse, then coordinate starts and endings with a partner.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 八拍次序完整，能跟随约定拍子。
successCriteria.bm: Urutan lapan detik lengkap dan mengikut detik bersama.
successCriteria.en: The eight-count sequence is complete and follows the agreed pulse.

successCriteria.zh: 与伙伴同拍开始、结束，并保留安全间距。
successCriteria.bm: Mula dan tamat serentak dengan rakan sambil menjaga jarak.
successCriteria.en: Start and end with the partner while preserving safe spacing.

instructions.zh: 在教师认可的垫面练习已教过的低位平衡；说明支撑点并在教师指导下安全进出姿势。
instructions.bm: Pada permukaan beralas yang diluluskan guru, lakukan imbangan rendah yang telah diajar; kenal pasti titik sokongan dan masuk/keluar posisi dengan bimbingan.
instructions.en: On a teacher-approved mat, demonstrate a taught low balance; identify support points and enter and leave the position under guidance.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 能指出实际支撑点并维持所学低位平衡。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti titik sokongan dan lakukan imbangan rendah yang diajar.
successCriteria.en: Identify support points and demonstrate the taught low balance.

successCriteria.zh: 按教师所教步骤进入及离开姿势，没有加入未教动作。
successCriteria.bm: Masuk dan keluar posisi mengikut langkah guru tanpa gerakan tambahan.
successCriteria.en: Enter and leave the position by the taught steps without adding untaught moves.

instructions.zh: 按教师画的校内简图，在安全指定范围辨认三个地标并规划次序；说明路线选择，不离开监督范围。
instructions.bm: Gunakan pelan sekolah daripada guru untuk mengenal tiga mercu tanda dalam kawasan selamat dan rancang urutannya; jelaskan pilihan tanpa keluar kawasan pengawasan.
instructions.en: Use a teacher-drawn school plan to identify three landmarks in a safe area and plan their order; explain the route without leaving the supervised area.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 地标次序与地图位置一致，没有越出指定范围。
successCriteria.bm: Urutan mercu tanda sepadan dengan pelan dan kekal dalam kawasan.
successCriteria.en: Landmark order agrees with the map and stays inside the designated area.

successCriteria.zh: 用地标或路径信息说明一次路线选择。
successCriteria.bm: Gunakan mercu tanda atau laluan untuk menjelaskan satu pilihan.
successCriteria.en: Explain a route choice using landmark or path information.

instructions.zh: 与教师讨论两种已教活动分别锻炼什么体能要素，安排热身、活动及放松的次序；实际强度由教师按个人情况调整。
instructions.bm: Bincang komponen kecergasan dalam dua aktiviti yang diajar; susun pemanasan, aktiviti dan penyejukan. Guru menyesuaikan intensiti mengikut individu.
instructions.en: Discuss which fitness components two taught activities involve and order warm-up, activity and cool-down. The teacher adapts intensity to the individual.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 将两项活动与体能要素配对，并说明动作依据。
successCriteria.bm: Padankan dua aktiviti dengan komponen kecergasan berserta alasan gerak.
successCriteria.en: Match both activities to fitness components and explain the movement basis.

successCriteria.zh: 计划列出热身、活动、放松的合理次序。
successCriteria.bm: Rancangan menyusun pemanasan, aktiviti dan penyejukan dengan munasabah.
successCriteria.en: The plan orders warm-up, activity and cool-down coherently.

title.zh: 适龄个人、情绪与社会健康
title.en: Age-appropriate personal, emotional and social health

instructions.zh: 用教师选定的适龄情境演练：清楚表达“不舒服／不愿意”，离开不安全情境，并向可信任成人求助；无需分享个人经历。
instructions.bm: Dengan situasi sesuai umur daripada guru, latih menyatakan tidak selesa/tidak setuju, menjauhi keadaan tidak selamat dan meminta bantuan orang dewasa dipercayai; tiada pendedahan pengalaman peribadi.
instructions.en: With a teacher-selected age-appropriate scenario, practise expressing discomfort/refusal, leaving an unsafe situation and seeking a trusted adult; no personal disclosure is required.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 能清楚表达拒绝或不舒服，并指出可信任的求助成人。
successCriteria.bm: Nyatakan penolakan atau ketidakselesaan dan kenal pasti orang dewasa dipercayai.
successCriteria.en: Express refusal or discomfort clearly and identify a trusted adult.

successCriteria.zh: 演练中不用泄露自己或他人的私事来说明理由。
successCriteria.bm: Lakonan tidak memerlukan pendedahan hal peribadi untuk memberi alasan.
successCriteria.en: The role-play explains the response without disclosing anyone’s private experience.

instructions.zh: 角色演练：同学在操场跌倒，表示不舒服。练习向学校成人报告地点、发生的事，并请成人到场处理。
instructions.bm: Lakonkan rakan jatuh di padang dan berasa tidak selesa. Latih melaporkan lokasi serta kejadian kepada orang dewasa sekolah dan meminta bantuan.
instructions.en: Role-play a classmate falling in the playground and feeling unwell. Practise reporting location and events to a school adult and requesting help.

instructions.zh: 在学校平面图标出教师办公室或指定求助点，说明怎样找到帮助。不要对真人进行治疗演练。
instructions.bm: Tandakan pejabat guru atau tempat bantuan pada pelan sekolah dan jelaskan cara mendapatkan bantuan. Jangan merawat orang sebenar.
instructions.en: Mark the staff office or designated help point on a school plan and explain how to reach help. Do not practise treatment on a person.

successCriteria.zh: 求助时能说明地点、发生的事及需要成人到场。
successCriteria.bm: Ketika meminta bantuan, nyatakan lokasi, kejadian dan keperluan orang dewasa.
successCriteria.en: A help request states the location, what happened and the need for an adult.

successCriteria.zh: 能指出学校规定的求助渠道，不把角色演练当作治疗。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti saluran bantuan sekolah dan bezakan lakonan daripada rawatan.
successCriteria.en: Identify the school’s help procedure and distinguish role-play from treatment.

instructions.zh: 阅读这组原创虚构标签：A每份25克含糖3克；B每份50克含糖5克。先抄下份量及单位，再把两者换算为每100克的糖量。
instructions.bm: Baca label rekaan: A, 3 g gula setiap sajian 25 g; B, 5 g gula setiap sajian 50 g. Catat saiz dan unit lalu tukar kedua-duanya kepada gula setiap 100 g.
instructions.en: Read these fictional labels: A has 3 g sugar per 25 g serving; B has 5 g per 50 g serving. Record serving sizes and units, then convert both to sugar per 100 g.

instructions.zh: 说明为什么“每份3克少于5克”不能直接证明A每100克糖更少。再写一项仅凭糖量无法判断的营养信息。这是标签阅读，不是个人饮食建议。
instructions.bm: Jelaskan mengapa 3 g berbanding 5 g setiap sajian tidak membuktikan A lebih rendah setiap 100 g. Nyatakan satu maklumat pemakanan yang tidak dapat diputuskan daripada gula sahaja. Ini latihan label, bukan nasihat diet individu.
instructions.en: Explain why 3 g versus 5 g per serving does not prove A has less sugar per 100 g. Identify one nutritional question that sugar values alone cannot answer. This is label literacy, not individual dietary advice.

successCriteria.zh: 换算得A每100克12克糖，B每100克10克糖，并保留单位。
successCriteria.bm: Pengiraan memberikan A 12 g dan B 10 g gula setiap 100 g dengan unit.
successCriteria.en: The calculation gives A 12 g and B 10 g sugar per 100 g, with units.

successCriteria.zh: 比较使用相同基准，并承认一种营养素不能概括全部营养价值。
successCriteria.bm: Perbandingan menggunakan asas sama dan mengakui satu nutrien tidak merangkumi semua nilai pemakanan.
successCriteria.en: The comparison uses the same basis and recognises that one nutrient does not establish total nutritional value.

instructions.zh: 三人用软球进行轻轻滚传练习，先写好传球、接球、观察三个角色，每三次交换角色；共同约定开始和停止信号。
instructions.bm: Tiga orang berlatih menggolek bola lembut. Tetapkan penghantar, penerima dan pemerhati serta tukar setiap tiga percubaan; persetujui isyarat mula dan berhenti.
instructions.en: In a three-person gentle soft-ball rolling drill, assign sender, receiver and observer roles and rotate every three attempts; agree start and stop signals.

instructions.zh: 观察者记录轮换是否按约定进行。若有人想多做一次，演练怎样提出请求、协商并清楚通知所有人，再评价调整是否公平。
instructions.bm: Pemerhati merekod giliran. Jika seseorang mahu satu percubaan tambahan, lakonkan permintaan, perbincangan dan pemberitahuan kepada semua, kemudian nilai keadilannya.
instructions.en: The observer records the rotation. If someone wants an extra attempt, role-play a request, agreement and clear notice to everyone, then evaluate fairness.

successCriteria.zh: 三人均获得约定角色，轮换记录与实际次序一致。
successCriteria.bm: Semua mendapat peranan yang dipersetujui dan rekod sepadan dengan urutan sebenar.
successCriteria.en: All three receive the agreed roles and the record matches the actual order.

successCriteria.zh: 规则调整经过沟通和同意，能说明对其他人的影响。
successCriteria.bm: Perubahan dibincang dan dipersetujui serta kesannya kepada orang lain dijelaskan.
successCriteria.en: Changes are communicated and agreed, with their effect on others explained.

title.zh: 马来西亚美术发展：制作与说明
title.bm: Perkembangan seni visual Malaysia: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Malaysian art development: make and explain

instructions.zh: 从教师提供的马来西亚美术机构资料选两件有作者、年代的作品，比较媒介和主题，并保留资料出处。
instructions.bm: Pilih dua karya Malaysia bertarikh dan bernama pengkarya daripada sumber institusi yang disediakan guru; bandingkan media dan tema serta catat sumber.
instructions.en: Select two dated Malaysian works with named artists from teacher-provided institutional sources; compare medium and theme and retain the source details.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 两件作品均保留可核对的作者、年代和出处。
successCriteria.bm: Kedua-dua karya mempunyai pengkarya, tarikh dan sumber yang boleh disemak.
successCriteria.en: Both works have checkable artists, dates and sources.

successCriteria.zh: 比较指出媒介或主题的具体相同与不同。
successCriteria.bm: Perbandingan menyatakan persamaan dan perbezaan khusus media atau tema.
successCriteria.en: The comparison identifies specific similarities and differences in medium or theme.

title.zh: 美术元素与设计原则：制作与说明
title.bm: Unsur seni dan prinsip rekaan: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Elements and design principles: make and explain

instructions.zh: 画同一片叶子的两幅图：一幅强调轮廓，一幅强调纹理。圈出你作出的两处不同选择。
instructions.bm: Lukis daun yang sama dua kali: tonjolkan garisan luar pada satu dan jalinan pada satu lagi. Tandakan dua pilihan berbeza.
instructions.en: Draw the same leaf twice: emphasise outline in one and texture in the other. Mark two different choices.

instructions.zh: 选教师已教的短歌，先标出换气处，再按稳定拍子唱一个乐句；录一次并指出一个可改进的位置。
instructions.bm: Pilih lagu pendek yang telah diajar, tandakan tempat nafas dan nyanyi satu frasa dengan detik stabil; rakam dan kenal pasti satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Use a short song already taught, mark breathing points and sing a phrase with a steady pulse; record it and identify one improvement.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 乐句按稳定拍子开始和结束，换气不割裂词语。
successCriteria.bm: Frasa bermula dan tamat dengan detik stabil; nafas tidak memutuskan perkataan.
successCriteria.en: The phrase begins and ends with a steady pulse, without breathing mid-word.

successCriteria.zh: 指出录音中一个具体时间位置及可改进之处。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti satu masa dalam rakaman dan pembaikan yang diperlukan.
successCriteria.en: Identify a particular moment in the recording and a useful improvement.

instructions.zh: 按教师给的四拍图示，以拍手或打击乐器演奏两次，保留休止的时间，再与伙伴一起演奏。
instructions.bm: Mainkan corak ikon empat detik dua kali dengan tepukan atau perkusi, kekalkan masa rehat, kemudian main bersama rakan.
instructions.en: Perform a teacher-provided four-beat icon pattern twice by clapping or percussion, preserve rest time, then play with a partner.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 四拍总时值完整，休止时拍子不中断。
successCriteria.bm: Empat detik lengkap dan detik diteruskan semasa rehat.
successCriteria.en: All four beats are accounted for and the pulse continues through rests.

successCriteria.zh: 第二次与伙伴在约定的拍点进入和结束。
successCriteria.bm: Ulangan bersama rakan bermula dan tamat pada detik yang dipersetujui.
successCriteria.en: The partner repeat begins and ends on the agreed beats.

instructions.zh: 写一段四小节旋律或节奏，标清拍号及休止；演奏、录音并修改一小节，解释修改的效果。
instructions.bm: Tulis melodi atau irama empat bar dengan meter dan rehat; main, rakam dan pinda satu bar serta jelaskan kesannya.
instructions.en: Write a four-bar melody or rhythm with meter and rests; perform, record and revise one bar, explaining the effect.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 谱或图示与实际演奏的声音及休止一致。
successCriteria.bm: Skor atau ikon sepadan dengan bunyi serta rehat yang dimainkan.
successCriteria.en: The notation or icons match the performed sounds and rests.

successCriteria.zh: 说明修改了哪一处，以及声音怎样改变。
successCriteria.bm: Nyatakan bahagian yang dipinda dan kesan bunyinya.
successCriteria.en: Identify the revision and explain its audible effect.

instructions.zh: 聆听教师提供并标明文化来源的两段音乐。记录听到的音色、速度或力度差异，并说明一项判断的听觉依据。
instructions.bm: Dengar dua petikan dengan sumber budaya yang dikenal pasti oleh guru. Catat perbezaan warna ton, tempo atau dinamik dan beri bukti pendengaran.
instructions.en: Listen to two teacher-selected excerpts with identified cultural provenance. Note differences in timbre, tempo or dynamics and give audible evidence.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 两段音乐的来源标签记录准确。
successCriteria.bm: Label sumber kedua-dua petikan direkodkan dengan tepat.
successCriteria.en: Both excerpts’ source labels are recorded accurately.

successCriteria.zh: 用听到的音色、速度或力度证据支持比较。
successCriteria.bm: Gunakan bukti warna ton, tempo atau dinamik yang didengar.
successCriteria.en: Support the comparison with heard timbre, tempo or dynamic evidence.

instructions.zh: 小组安排一段短表演，分配歌唱、伴奏或动作角色，约定开始与结束信号；排练后检查是否协调。
instructions.bm: Rancang persembahan pendek dengan peranan nyanyian, iringan atau gerak serta isyarat mula/tamat; semak penyelarasan selepas latihan.
instructions.en: Plan a short performance with singing, accompaniment or movement roles and start/end cues; review coordination after rehearsal.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 角色和进入、结束信号有明确记录并得到使用。
successCriteria.bm: Peranan serta isyarat mula/tamat direkodkan dan digunakan.
successCriteria.en: Roles and start/end cues are recorded clearly and used.

successCriteria.zh: 排练后指出一次具体的协调问题及调整。
successCriteria.bm: Selepas latihan, kenal pasti satu isu penyelarasan dan pelarasan.
successCriteria.en: After rehearsal, identify a specific coordination problem and adjustment.

titleI18n.bm: Tunjukkan peminjaman dan sahkan hasil
titleI18n.en: Show borrowing and verify a difference

materials.bm: Kertas berpetak dan pensel. Soalan: A = 1000000₂ − 0010111₂; B = 1011011₂ − 0101101₂. Sifar di hadapan hanya untuk penjajaran nilai tempat.
materials.en: Squared paper and pencil. Problems: A = 1000000₂ − 0010111₂; B = 1011011₂ − 0101101₂. Leading zeros only align place values.

instructions: Salin A dan B dalam bentuk lazim. Labelkan nilai tempat 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 dan 1; hitung setiap penolakan dalam perduaan. Tunjukkan setiap lajur penderma dan nilai selepas peminjaman.

Semak setiap hasil dengan penambahan perduaan: hasil + nombor yang ditolak mesti sama dengan nombor asal. Tunjukkan pembawaan. Penukaran kepada perpuluhan boleh menjadi semakan tambahan tetapi tidak menggantikan kerja perduaan.

Untuk A, seorang murid menulis 1101001₂ selepas terlupa mengurangkan lajur nilai 64 semasa peminjaman. Bandingkan dengan kerja anda. Terangkan mengapa hasil itu tidak mungkin betul dan tunjukkan pembetulan pada lajur berkenaan.

Cipta satu lagi penolakan dua nombor perduaan bukan negatif, dengan nombor pertama lebih besar. Pilih kes yang memerlukan peminjaman melalui sekurang-kurangnya satu lajur sifar. Selesaikan, semak dengan penambahan dan jelaskan laluan peminjaman kepada rakan.

bm: Salin A dan B dalam bentuk lazim. Labelkan nilai tempat 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 dan 1; hitung setiap penolakan dalam perduaan. Tunjukkan setiap lajur penderma dan nilai selepas peminjaman.

Cipta satu lagi penolakan dua nombor perduaan bukan negatif, dengan nombor pertama lebih besar. Pilih kes yang memerlukan peminjaman melalui sekurang-kurangnya satu lajur sifar. Selesaikan, semak dengan penambahan dan jelaskan laluan peminjaman kepada rakan.
en: Copy A and B in columns. Label place values 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1; calculate each subtraction in binary. Show every donor column and its value after borrowing.
Check each result by binary addition: difference + subtracted number must equal the original number. Show carries. Decimal conversion may be an extra check but does not replace the binary working.
For A, a pupil writes 1101001₂ after forgetting to reduce the 64s donor column. Compare this with your work. Explain why the result cannot be correct and show the correction in that column.

Create one more subtraction of two non-negative binary numbers with the first larger. Choose a case requiring borrowing through at least one zero column. Solve it, check by addition and explain the borrowing path to a peer.

successCriteria: A dan B dikira dengan penjajaran nilai tempat serta pengumpulan semula yang mengekalkan nilai.
Kedua-dua semakan penambahan perduaan ditunjukkan dengan pembawaan yang betul.
Ralat lajur penderma dikenal pasti dan pembetulan dikaitkan dengan nilai nombor asal.
Contoh ciptaan sendiri memerlukan peminjaman melalui sifar, diselesaikan dan diterangkan dengan betul.

en: A and B have aligned place values and regrouping that preserves value.
Both binary addition checks are shown with correct carries.
The donor-column error is identified and the correction is related to the original value.
The self-created example requires borrowing through zero and is solved and explained correctly.

teacherGuide.bm: A: 64 − 23 = 41 = 0101001₂; semak 0101001₂ + 0010111₂ = 1000000₂. B: 91 − 45 = 46 = 0101110₂; semak 0101110₂ + 0101101₂ = 1011011₂. Cadangan salah 1101001₂ = 105 melebihi 64 walaupun 23 ditolak. Lajur nilai 64 perlu menjadi 0. Terima contoh murid yang memenuhi syarat; semak peminjaman sebenar, bukan jawapan akhir sahaja. Tiada satu contoh ciptaan yang diwajibkan.
teacherGuide.en: A: 64 − 23 = 41 = 0101001₂; check 0101001₂ + 0010111₂ = 1000000₂. B: 91 − 45 = 46 = 0101110₂; check 0101110₂ + 0101101₂ = 1011011₂. The wrong proposal 1101001₂ = 105 exceeds 64 despite subtracting 23. The 64s column must become 0. Accept any pupil example meeting the conditions; inspect the borrowing, not just the answer. No particular self-created example is prescribed.

submission.bm: Serahkan dua pengiraan asal, dua semakan, penerangan ralat dan contoh ciptaan sendiri yang lengkap.
submission.en: Submit the two calculations, two checks, error explanation and a fully worked self-created example.

titleI18n.bm: Pulihkan dan uji mesej ASCII
titleI18n.en: Recover and test an ASCII message

materials.bm: Kertas, pensel dan jadual ini. Semua kod ialah ASCII 7 bit dengan satu sifar pendahuluan; semua offset ialah perduaan. Jadual: A = 01000001₂; B = 01000010₂; C = 01000011₂; D = 01000100₂; E = 01000101₂; F = 01000110₂; G = 01000111₂; H = 01001000₂; I = 01001001₂; J = 01001010₂; K = 01001011₂; L = 01001100₂; M = 01001101₂; N = 01001110₂; O = 01001111₂; P = 01010000₂; Q = 01010001₂; R = 01010010₂; S = 01010011₂; T = 01010100₂; U = 01010101₂; V = 01010110₂; W = 01010111₂; X = 01011000₂; Y = 01011001₂; Z = 01011010₂. Peraturan pengirim: tambah 00000101₂ pada kod setiap aksara asal, kemudian tolak 00000010₂. Tiga kod diterima dalam urutan: 01010000₂, 01000100₂, 01010011₂.
materials.en: Paper, pencil and this table. Codes are 7-bit ASCII with one leading zero; all offsets are binary. Table: A = 01000001₂; B = 01000010₂; C = 01000011₂; D = 01000100₂; E = 01000101₂; F = 01000110₂; G = 01000111₂; H = 01001000₂; I = 01001001₂; J = 01001010₂; K = 01001011₂; L = 01001100₂; M = 01001101₂; N = 01001110₂; O = 01001111₂; P = 01010000₂; Q = 01010001₂; R = 01010010₂; S = 01010011₂; T = 01010100₂; U = 01010101₂; V = 01010110₂; W = 01010111₂; X = 01011000₂; Y = 01011001₂; Z = 01011010₂. Sender rule: add 00000101₂ to each original character code, then subtract 00000010₂. Three codes are received in order: 01010000₂, 01000100₂, 01010011₂.

instructions: Tuliskan dua operasi untuk membatalkan peraturan pengirim. Terangkan mengapa penolakan terakhir perlu dibatalkan dengan penambahan, kemudian penambahan pertama dibatalkan dengan penolakan.
Pulihkan ketiga-tiga kod asal. Tunjukkan kedua-dua operasi perduaan dan hasil perantaraan bagi setiap kod, kemudian gunakan jadual untuk mendapatkan mesej asal tiga aksara dalam urutan yang betul.
Laksanakan peraturan pengirim ke atas setiap kod asal yang anda pulihkan. Tunjukkan kerja perduaan dan sahkan bahawa ketiga-tiga kod yang diterima dapat dihasilkan semula.

Seorang rakan hanya menolak 00000101₂ daripada setiap kod yang diterima. Jelaskan operasi songsang yang tertinggal. Gunakan kod diterima pertama untuk menunjukkan hasil kaedah salah dan hasil pembetulan.

Pilih sendiri tiga huruf besar antara A hingga W supaya kod yang diubah kekal sebagai huruf besar. Bentuk mesej baharu, lakukan kedua-dua operasi dan minta rakan memulihkannya. Catat kod dihantar, kod dipulihkan dan sebarang pembetulan.

en: Write the two operations that undo the sender rule. Explain why the last subtraction is undone by addition, then the first addition by subtraction.
Recover all three original codes. Show both binary operations and the intermediate result for each code, then use the table to obtain the original three-character message in the correct order.
Apply the sender rule to every recovered original code. Show binary working and verify that it reproduces all three received codes.
A peer only subtracts 00000101₂ from each received code. Explain the missing inverse operation. Use the first received code to show the incorrect result and the corrected result.

Choose your own three uppercase letters from A to W so the transformed codes remain uppercase letters. Form a new message, perform both operations and ask a peer to recover it. Record the sent codes, recovered codes and any correction.

Ketiga-tiga kod dan aksara asal dipulihkan dengan hasil perantaraan serta kerja perduaan.
Semakan ke hadapan menghasilkan semula kod yang diterima.
Operasi tertinggal dalam kaedah rakan dikenal pasti dan dibetulkan menggunakan contoh.
Mesej ciptaan sendiri melalui proses kod, pemulihan dan semakan yang direkodkan.

All three original codes and characters are recovered with intermediate results and binary working.

The omitted operation in the peer method is identified and corrected using the example.
The self-created message has a recorded encoding, recovery and checking process.

teacherGuide.bm: Operasi songsang ialah tambah 00000010₂ kemudian tolak 00000101₂. Kod pertama: 01010000₂ + 00000010₂ = 01010010₂; tolak 00000101₂ memberi 01001101₂ (M). Kod kedua: 01000100₂ + 00000010₂ = 01000110₂; tolak 00000101₂ memberi 01000001₂ (A). Kod ketiga: 01010011₂ + 00000010₂ = 01010101₂; tolak 00000101₂ memberi 01010000₂ (P). Mesej MAP. Semakan ke hadapan: M → 01010010₂ → 01010000₂; A → 01000110₂ → 01000100₂; P → 01010101₂ → 01010011₂. Kaedah rakan untuk kod pertama memberi 01001011₂ (K), dua unit di bawah kod asal kerana gagal membatalkan penolakan 2. Contoh murid mungkin berbeza; semak setiap perantaraan. Peraturan perubahan kod ini hanyalah latihan aritmetik, bukan kaedah keselamatan data.
teacherGuide.en: The inverse operations are add 00000010₂ then subtract 00000101₂. First: 01010000₂ + 00000010₂ = 01010010₂; subtracting 00000101₂ gives 01001101₂ (M). Second: 01000100₂ + 00000010₂ = 01000110₂; subtracting 00000101₂ gives 01000001₂ (A). Third: 01010011₂ + 00000010₂ = 01010101₂; subtracting 00000101₂ gives 01010000₂ (P). The message is MAP. Forward checks: M → 01010010₂ → 01010000₂; A → 01000110₂ → 01000100₂; P → 01010101₂ → 01010011₂. The peer method gives 01001011₂ (K) for the first code, two below the original because it fails to undo subtracting 2. Pupil examples may differ; check every intermediate value. This code-changing rule is an arithmetic exercise, not a data-security method.

submission.en: Submit intermediate calculations, the three original characters, forward checks, error correction and the record for the self-created message.

titleI18n.en: Build a plan and a checked activity notice

materials.bm: Gunakan kertas atau editor dokumen. Semua rekod berikut ialah data latihan yang disahkan untuk minggu yang sama: Robotik — Isnin, 14:00, Makmal 2, 12 tempat, kertas asal biru; Bacaan — Isnin, 14:30, Perpustakaan, 20 tempat, kertas asal hijau; Koir — Selasa, 13:00, Bilik Muzik, 16 tempat, kertas asal kuning. Notis perlu memberitahu murid nama aktiviti, hari, masa mula, tempat dan had peserta. Warna kertas asal tidak mempengaruhi aktiviti. Draf lama menyatakan tempat Koir ialah Dewan. Jangan terbitkan ke laman sebenar; hasilkan draf untuk dinilai.
materials.en: Use paper or a document editor. These are verified practice records for the same week: Robotics — Monday, 14:00, Lab 2, 12 places, original card blue; Reading — Monday, 14:30, Library, 20 places, original card green; Choir — Tuesday, 13:00, Music Room, 16 places, original card yellow. The notice must tell pupils each activity name, day, starting time, location and participant limit. Original card colour does not affect the activity. An old draft gives Hall as the Choir location. Do not publish to a real site; produce a draft for assessment.

instructions: Pecahkan tugasan menghasilkan notis kepada sekurang-kurangnya empat subtugas. Bagi setiap subtugas, tulis input yang diperlukan dan hasil yang diserahkan kepada subtugas seterusnya. Bezakan semakan data sumber daripada semakan draf gabungan.

Lukis anak panah kebergantungan antara subtugas. Tandakan mana-mana subtugas yang boleh berjalan serentak, atau jelaskan mengapa pelan anda menggunakan urutan sepenuhnya. Pengesahan draf mesti berlaku sebelum draf dianggap sedia untuk diedarkan.

en: Split making the notice into at least four subtasks. For each, state the required inputs and the output passed to the next subtask. Distinguish checking source data from checking the combined draft.

Draw dependency arrows between subtasks. Mark any that can run in parallel, or explain why your plan is entirely sequential. Draft approval must happen before the draft is treated as ready for distribution.
Make a table of the information to retain. Name one field that can be omitted and explain why omitting it does not affect the notice’s purpose. Do not drop information pupils need.
Produce the actual notice using the selected data. Check every row against the verified records. Identify the Choir-location conflict in the old draft and record the correction and its basis.

Ask a peer to use your notice to find the Choir location and time and the Robotics participant limit. Record the answers and one improvement if information is hard to find; if there is no problem, record that check result.

teacherGuide.bm: Pelan yang munasabah termasuk mengesahkan rekod, memilih medan, menyusun draf, menyemak setiap padanan dan meluluskan draf. Semakan rekod aktiviti berbeza boleh selari sebelum draf digabungkan; pelan urutan sepenuhnya juga boleh diterima jika beralasan. Lima medan diperlukan: aktiviti, hari, masa mula, tempat, had peserta. Warna kertas asal boleh ditinggalkan. Koir mesti Bilik Muzik, Selasa 13:00, 16 tempat; Robotik 12 tempat. Jangan menerima semakan jumlah baris sahaja sebagai bukti ketepatan semua medan. Penerbitan sebenar tidak diperlukan.
teacherGuide.en: A defensible plan can verify records, select fields, draft the notice, check each match and approve the draft. Separate activity records can be checked in parallel before merging; an explained sequential plan is also acceptable. Required fields are activity, day, starting time, location and participant limit. Original card colour may be omitted. Choir must be Music Room, Tuesday 13:00, 16 places; Robotics has 12 places. Checking only the row count does not establish field accuracy. Real publication is not required.

titleI18n.bm: Bandingkan permintaan dan bina aturan boleh guna semula
titleI18n.en: Compare requests and build a reusable allocation rule

materials.bm: Setiap kelab mempunyai satu tempat. Tempat diberi kepada pemohon layak yang tiba paling awal; jika tiada yang layak, tiada tawaran dibuat. Kelayakan Sukan ialah izin penjaga: S1 08:10 tidak; S2 08:15 ya; S3 08:05 ya. Kelayakan Kebun ialah hadir taklimat: G1 08:02 ya; G2 08:00 tidak; G3 08:04 ya. Kelayakan Muzik ialah siap latihan persediaan: M1 08:00 tidak; M2 08:01 tidak. Semua masa pada hari sama. Kod pemohon unik dalam kelab. Gunakan kertas atau editor dokumen; data ialah rekaan untuk latihan.
materials.en: Each club has one place. It goes to the earliest eligible applicant; if none is eligible, no offer is made. Sports eligibility is guardian consent: S1 08:10 no; S2 08:15 yes; S3 08:05 yes. Garden eligibility is attendance at briefing: G1 08:02 yes; G2 08:00 no; G3 08:04 yes. Music eligibility is completed preparation: M1 08:00 no; M2 08:01 no. All times are on the same day. Applicant codes are unique within each club. Use paper or a document editor; these are invented practice data.

instructions: Bina jadual perbandingan ketiga-tiga masalah. Nyatakan ciri yang sama dan ciri yang berbeza. Bezakan tujuan bersama daripada jenis bukti kelayakan yang berbeza.

Tentukan data yang diperlukan oleh aturan umum anda dan data yang khusus kepada satu kelab. Jelaskan bagaimana aturan boleh menerima keputusan semakan kelayakan tanpa menggunakan jenis syarat Sukan untuk semua kelab.

Tulis langkah aturan umum atau lukis carta langkah yang menentukan penerima. Sertakan keadaan tiada pemohon layak. Jejak aturan pada Sukan, Kebun dan Muzik, dengan menunjukkan rekod yang dikekalkan atau disingkirkan serta keputusan akhir.
Uji cadangan salah “pilih masa paling awal daripada semua rekod”. Gunakan data Kebun untuk menunjukkan mengapa cadangan itu gagal, kemudian nyatakan pembaikan.

Cipta kelab keempat dengan syarat kelayakan yang berbeza dan sekurang-kurangnya tiga rekod. Sertakan dua pemohon layak pada masa yang sama. Cadangkan aturan seri yang jelas dan konsisten, kemudian jejak contoh baharu. Terangkan bahawa aturan seri ialah pilihan tambahan anda, bukan bukti yang boleh disimpulkan daripada tiga set asal.

en: Make a comparison table for the three problems. Identify shared and differing features. Distinguish the common goal from the different types of eligibility evidence.
Decide what data your general rule needs and what is specific to one club. Explain how the rule can take the result of an eligibility check without imposing the Sports condition on every club.

Write a general step sequence or draw a process diagram to select a recipient. Include the case with no eligible applicant. Trace the rule for Sports, Garden and Music, showing records retained or removed and the final decision.
Test the flawed proposal “choose the earliest time from all records”. Use Garden data to show why it fails, then state the repair.

Create a fourth club with a different eligibility requirement and at least three records. Include two eligible applicants at the same time. Propose a clear, consistent tie rule, then trace the new example. Explain that the tie rule is your added design choice, not something established by the original three datasets.

successCriteria: Jadual mengenal pasti tujuan dan struktur bersama serta perbezaan bukti kelayakan.
Aturan menggunakan data yang perlu tanpa menggantikan syarat kelayakan satu kelab dengan syarat kelab lain.
Jejak asal memberikan S3, G1 dan tiada tawaran untuk Muzik, dengan alasan berdasarkan rekod.
Contoh Kebun menunjukkan ralat memilih G2 yang awal tetapi tidak layak; aturan dibaiki.
Contoh baharu dan aturan seri boleh dilaksanakan secara konsisten, dengan pilihan reka bentuk dibezakan daripada corak yang diperhatikan.

en: The comparison identifies the shared goal and structure and the differing eligibility evidence.
The rule uses necessary data without substituting one club’s eligibility condition for another’s.
The original traces yield S3, G1 and no Music offer, with record-based reasons.
The Garden example exposes selecting early but ineligible G2; the rule is repaired.
The new example and tie rule can be applied consistently, distinguishing a design choice from an observed pattern.

teacherGuide.bm: Ciri bersama ialah satu tempat, semakan kelayakan, masa ketibaan dan keutamaan masa terawal antara yang layak. Bukti kelayakan berubah mengikut kelab. Tapis dahulu: Sukan mengekalkan S2/S3 lalu memilih S3; Kebun mengekalkan G1/G3 lalu memilih G1; Muzik tiada yang layak. G2 tidak boleh dipilih hanya kerana 08:00 paling awal. Bagi seri, terima aturan tambahan yang jelas seperti kod menaik, atau proses cabutan yang prosedurnya ditetapkan, jika murid menerangkan keputusan dan konsistensinya. Jangan mendakwa aturan seri unik dapat diperoleh daripada contoh asal yang tiada seri. Nilai jejak sebenar, bukan nama teknik sahaja.
teacherGuide.en: Shared features are one place, an eligibility check, arrival time and earliest-time priority among eligible applicants. Eligibility evidence differs by club. Filter first: Sports retains S2/S3 and selects S3; Garden retains G1/G3 and selects G1; Music has no eligible applicant. G2 cannot be selected merely because 08:00 is earliest. For a tie, accept a clear added rule such as ascending code, or a draw with a defined procedure, if the pupil explains its operation and consistency. Do not claim a unique tie rule can be inferred from original examples without ties. Assess actual traces rather than technique names alone.

submission.en: Submit the comparison table, data list, general rule, three traces, error analysis and fourth-club example with its tie trace.

instructions: Pasangan membaca pesanan berikut dua kali; pendengar tidak melihat teks.

instructions: Tulis cadangan kepada kelab untuk menggunakan semula bahan. Sertakan alasan, satu bantahan munasabah dan jawapan kamu.
Bezakan bukti dengan andaian. Semak penanda hubungan dan baiki hujah yang lemah.

performanceTasks.title: Seni bahasa: lafaz, tafsir dan cipta
instructions: Rina menaip balasan yang tajam. Dia teringat pesanan supaya bertanya dahulu sebelum menuduh. Balasan itu disimpan sebagai draf. Esoknya, dia menemui rakannya untuk mendengar penjelasan.
Huraikan tindakan atau pertentangan dalam petikan dengan dua bukti. Tulis sambungan pendek yang mengekalkan watak dan jelaskan pilihan kamu.

instructions: A partner reads the following script twice; the listener does not read it.
A pupil wants longer library hours. A staff member explains that the present staffing schedule is already full.
Represent both views fairly and agree a limited trial that takes staffing into account.
Swap roles, then check the retelling against the original message.

instructions: Write a proposal for your club to reuse materials. Explain a benefit, a practical difficulty and a response to it.

instructions:
The Unsent Message (original story)
Rina wrote a sharp reply and hovered over Send. Across the desk lay a note from yesterday: “Ask what happened before deciding why.” She saved her message as a draft. The next morning she asked her teammate about the missing work.

Read or perform your response to a partner. Use their feedback to improve one part.
successCriteria: The response fits the events in the text.

The created response is understandable and reviewed.

performanceTasks.title: 协商不同需要
instructions: 同伴把下列材料读两遍，听者不看文字。
学生建议延长图书馆开放时间，管理员说明现有值班表已经排满。
分别说明双方的需要，提出一个兼顾人手的试行方案，并回应同伴的疑问。
交换角色，再用原文核对复述的内容。
successCriteria: 主要资料准确。
回应符合情境要求。
能礼貌提问或改正听错的资料。

performanceTasks.title: 有转折的记叙
instructions: 写一次误会的经过，可以从结果写起，再交代事情怎样发生和解决。
检查倒叙与顺叙衔接是否清楚，保留关键细节，修改重复或跳跃的部分。
保留初稿和修改稿，并说明一处修改的理由。
successCriteria: 内容符合目的和读者。
表达顺序清楚。
修改改善意思、字词或标点。

performanceTasks.title: 古诗朗读与理解：登鹳雀楼
instructions: 补充选读《登鹳雀楼》／王之涣：白日依山尽，黄河入海流。欲穷千里目，更上一层楼。
先按词语意思划分停顿，听同伴朗读后互相指出一处需要调整的读音或停顿。
先解释登楼看到的景象，再讨论后两句怎样写出想看得更远的愿望。
熟读后尝试背诵；再用自己的话解释一处诗句。该选读不代替学校规定的全年诗目。
successCriteria: 读音和停顿基本准确。
解释引用诗中的具体依据。
能根据反馈改进朗读，不把背得流利等同于已经理解。

performanceTasks.title: 文化资料的说明与交流
instructions: 选清明、端午、中秋或亲属称谓中的一个主题，查阅学校课本或一项署名资料。
记录资料名称、作者或机构及出处，用自己的话解释两个术语。
向同伴作简短说明，区分资料中的说明、家庭个别做法和自己的感受；回答一个追问。
successCriteria: 术语解释有可追查的出处。
不把个人家庭习惯说成所有人的做法。
说明有顺序，并回应听众的问题。

performanceTasks.title: 把事实写成清楚的校园报道
instructions: 根据以下原创采访记录，为没有到场的同学写一段100至150字的校刊报道：摄影社原定周三在操场交流作品；当天早上下雨，活动改到礼堂；同学先分组介绍照片，再根据同伴提问修改说明文字；活动结束时，各组都完成了修改。不得加入材料没有提供的获奖或人数等事实。
用一组恰当的关联词说明遇到的困难与实际结果，再用准确的动词说明同学怎样改进作品说明。写完后圈出关联词，注明它连接的两层意思。
请同伴只根据采访记录核对你的初稿。保留初稿和修改稿，至少改进一处用词或句子，并用一至两句话解释修改怎样让意思更准确。
successCriteria: 保留活动地点改变和作品说明修改的关键事实，不把预测写成已经发生的结果。
关联词表达的关系与前后事实相符，用词能准确交代行动。
提供初稿、修改稿和明确的修改理由；由同伴或教师核对，不能只交一道选择题的答案。

performanceTasks.title: Compare two fares
instructions: Fare A is y = 2x + 3 and fare B is y = 3x + 1 for distances 0 to 5 km.
Tabulate both at integer x values and draw them on common labelled axes. Identify when they are equal.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: The graphs meet at (2,7); A costs less above 2 km and B below 2 km.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Choose a typical value
instructions: Five journey times are 10, 11, 11, 12 and 46 minutes.
Calculate mean, median and mode. Explain which best represents an ordinary journey and why.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Mean 18, median 11 and mode 11; the unusually long journey pulls the mean upward.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.

performanceTasks.title: Food-web consequence
instructions: Draw grass → grasshopper → frog → snake, plus grass → mouse → snake; arrows show food-to-consumer energy transfer.
Predict one possible consequence of fewer frogs and explain why the whole web matters.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: A supported prediction, with the alternative mouse route acknowledged; no claim that every population must change in one fixed way.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Trace absorption
instructions: Label mouth, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine and large intestine on a supplied outline.
Trace starch-containing food and distinguish digestion from absorption; annotate one villus adaptation.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Digestion breaks down food; absorption moves soluble nutrients into transport systems; large surface area supports absorption.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Break a transmission chain
instructions: For a classroom model, connect cards for pathogen, infected host, transmission route and susceptible host.
For a respiratory infection scenario, compare ventilation and cleaning drinking-water measures; explain which acts most directly on the stated route.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Prevention is matched to transmission route; the model is not used to diagnose a person.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Solubility and temperature
instructions: Use supplied data: at 20°C a sample dissolves 30 g per 100 g water; at 40°C it dissolves 45 g. A mixture has 40 g solute in 100 g water.
Predict dissolved and undissolved amounts at each temperature and state what is held constant.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: At 20°C, 30 g dissolves and 10 g remains; at 40°C all 40 g can dissolve.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Sound needs a medium
instructions: Watch a teacher-approved bell-jar demonstration/video in which a ringing bell stays visibly vibrating as air is removed.
Record the visible motion and change in loudness; compare the two observations.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: The weaker sound is linked to reduced transmission medium, not to the bell ceasing to vibrate.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Classify astronomical objects
instructions: Use textbook images of the Sun, the Milky Way and an external galaxy, recording each image source.
Describe which object is a star and which is a collection of stars; explain why appearance alone can be misleading.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Distinguish a star from a galaxy and state one limit of a photograph.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Scale a distance model

Mark the three distances on a line and explain why planet sizes must use a different scale in a small classroom model.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Distances 2 cm, 10.4 cm and 60 cm; distinguish distance scale from size scale.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Follow one small object
instructions: Draw a small rocky object in space, its luminous passage through the atmosphere and a surviving piece on the ground.
Label each stage and compare that sequence with the icy composition and tail of a comet.

successCriteria: Meteoroid → meteor → meteorite; a comet is not simply another stage in that sequence.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

instructions.zh: 与教师选定一件有关“道德概念”的日常小事，先说明涉及谁、他们需要什么，再比较两个可行做法。
instructions.bm: Bersama guru, pilih satu kejadian harian berkaitan Pengenalan moral. Nyatakan pihak dan keperluannya, kemudian bandingkan dua tindakan yang boleh dilakukan.
instructions.en: With the teacher, choose one everyday incident involving Moral concepts. Identify the people and their needs, then compare two feasible actions.

instructions.zh: 演练所选做法及礼貌说法。之后说明对方可能的感受，以及自己需要调整的一点。不要公开别人的私事。
instructions.bm: Lakonkan tindakan dan kata-kata sopan. Jelaskan perasaan pihak terlibat serta satu pembaikan diri. Jangan dedahkan hal peribadi orang lain.
instructions.en: Rehearse the action and respectful wording. Explain the other person’s likely feelings and one improvement. Do not disclose someone else’s private matter.

successCriteria.zh: 指出情境中不同人的需要，并给出与事实有关的理由。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti keperluan pihak terlibat dan beri alasan berkaitan fakta.
successCriteria.en: Identify the people’s needs and give a reason tied to the facts.

successCriteria.zh: 演练的说法和行动一致，并能解释对他人的影响。
successCriteria.bm: Kata-kata dan tindakan dalam lakonan selaras serta kesannya dapat dijelaskan.
successCriteria.en: The role-play’s words and actions agree, and their effect on others is explained.

instructions.zh: 在教师确认安全的平地，用软球与伙伴练习朝两个标记之间轻轻滚传。先确认对方准备，再各试三次；高年级可在教师许可下比较两个距离。
instructions.bm: Di permukaan rata yang disahkan selamat, golek bola lembut perlahan melalui dua penanda kepada rakan. Pastikan penerima bersedia dan cuba tiga kali; murid lebih tinggi boleh membandingkan dua jarak dengan izin guru.
instructions.en: On a teacher-approved level surface, gently roll a soft ball between two markers to a partner. Confirm readiness and try three times each; older pupils may compare two distances with teacher approval.

instructions.zh: 记录球从目标左、右或中间通过。只调整一次出手方向，再比较结果。
instructions.bm: Catat sama ada bola melalui kiri, kanan atau tengah sasaran. Laraskan arah pelepasan sekali dan bandingkan hasil.
instructions.en: Record whether the ball passes left, right or through the target. Adjust release direction once and compare the result.

successCriteria.zh: 出手前确认伙伴准备，动作朝指定目标完成。
successCriteria.bm: Pastikan rakan bersedia dan arahkan gerakan ke sasaran.
successCriteria.en: Check partner readiness and direct the action towards the target.

successCriteria.zh: 比较三次尝试，指出一个动作提示和一次调整。
successCriteria.bm: Bandingkan tiga percubaan dan nyatakan petunjuk serta pelarasan.
successCriteria.en: Compare three attempts and identify one movement cue and adjustment.

instructions.zh: 跟随教师的八拍安全步伐组合；先单独保持拍子，再与伙伴协调起止，不加入未教的高难动作。
instructions.bm: Ikuti rangkaian langkah selamat lapan detik daripada guru; kekalkan detik sendiri lalu selaraskan mula/tamat dengan rakan.
instructions.en: Follow a safe eight-count step sequence taught by the teacher; keep the pulse, then coordinate starts and endings with a partner.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 八拍次序完整，能跟随约定拍子。
successCriteria.bm: Urutan lapan detik lengkap dan mengikut detik bersama.
successCriteria.en: The eight-count sequence is complete and follows the agreed pulse.

successCriteria.zh: 与伙伴同拍开始、结束，并保留安全间距。
successCriteria.bm: Mula dan tamat serentak dengan rakan sambil menjaga jarak.
successCriteria.en: Start and end with the partner while preserving safe spacing.

instructions.zh: 在教师认可的垫面练习已教过的低位平衡；说明支撑点并在教师指导下安全进出姿势。
instructions.bm: Pada permukaan beralas yang diluluskan guru, lakukan imbangan rendah yang telah diajar; kenal pasti titik sokongan dan masuk/keluar posisi dengan bimbingan.
instructions.en: On a teacher-approved mat, demonstrate a taught low balance; identify support points and enter and leave the position under guidance.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 能指出实际支撑点并维持所学低位平衡。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti titik sokongan dan lakukan imbangan rendah yang diajar.
successCriteria.en: Identify support points and demonstrate the taught low balance.

successCriteria.zh: 按教师所教步骤进入及离开姿势，没有加入未教动作。
successCriteria.bm: Masuk dan keluar posisi mengikut langkah guru tanpa gerakan tambahan.
successCriteria.en: Enter and leave the position by the taught steps without adding untaught moves.

instructions.zh: 按教师画的校内简图，在安全指定范围辨认三个地标并规划次序；说明路线选择，不离开监督范围。
instructions.bm: Gunakan pelan sekolah daripada guru untuk mengenal tiga mercu tanda dalam kawasan selamat dan rancang urutannya; jelaskan pilihan tanpa keluar kawasan pengawasan.
instructions.en: Use a teacher-drawn school plan to identify three landmarks in a safe area and plan their order; explain the route without leaving the supervised area.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 地标次序与地图位置一致，没有越出指定范围。
successCriteria.bm: Urutan mercu tanda sepadan dengan pelan dan kekal dalam kawasan.
successCriteria.en: Landmark order agrees with the map and stays inside the designated area.

successCriteria.zh: 用地标或路径信息说明一次路线选择。
successCriteria.bm: Gunakan mercu tanda atau laluan untuk menjelaskan satu pilihan.
successCriteria.en: Explain a route choice using landmark or path information.

instructions.zh: 与教师讨论两种已教活动分别锻炼什么体能要素，安排热身、活动及放松的次序；实际强度由教师按个人情况调整。
instructions.bm: Bincang komponen kecergasan dalam dua aktiviti yang diajar; susun pemanasan, aktiviti dan penyejukan. Guru menyesuaikan intensiti mengikut individu.
instructions.en: Discuss which fitness components two taught activities involve and order warm-up, activity and cool-down. The teacher adapts intensity to the individual.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 将两项活动与体能要素配对，并说明动作依据。
successCriteria.bm: Padankan dua aktiviti dengan komponen kecergasan berserta alasan gerak.
successCriteria.en: Match both activities to fitness components and explain the movement basis.

successCriteria.zh: 计划列出热身、活动、放松的合理次序。
successCriteria.bm: Rancangan menyusun pemanasan, aktiviti dan penyejukan dengan munasabah.
successCriteria.en: The plan orders warm-up, activity and cool-down coherently.

title.zh: 适龄个人、情绪与社会健康
title.en: Age-appropriate personal, emotional and social health

instructions.zh: 用教师选定的适龄情境演练：清楚表达“不舒服／不愿意”，离开不安全情境，并向可信任成人求助；无需分享个人经历。
instructions.bm: Dengan situasi sesuai umur daripada guru, latih menyatakan tidak selesa/tidak setuju, menjauhi keadaan tidak selamat dan meminta bantuan orang dewasa dipercayai; tiada pendedahan pengalaman peribadi.
instructions.en: With a teacher-selected age-appropriate scenario, practise expressing discomfort/refusal, leaving an unsafe situation and seeking a trusted adult; no personal disclosure is required.

instructions.zh: 用图示或简短记录重现刚才的次序，指出一个符合目标的做法及一个需要调整的地方。
instructions.bm: Lukis atau catat urutan, kenal pasti satu tindakan yang memenuhi sasaran dan satu pelarasan.
instructions.en: Draw or record the sequence, identify one action that met the target and one needed adjustment.

successCriteria.zh: 能清楚表达拒绝或不舒服，并指出可信任的求助成人。
successCriteria.bm: Nyatakan penolakan atau ketidakselesaan dan kenal pasti orang dewasa dipercayai.
successCriteria.en: Express refusal or discomfort clearly and identify a trusted adult.

successCriteria.zh: 演练中不用泄露自己或他人的私事来说明理由。
successCriteria.bm: Lakonan tidak memerlukan pendedahan hal peribadi untuk memberi alasan.
successCriteria.en: The role-play explains the response without disclosing anyone’s private experience.

instructions.zh: 角色演练：同学在操场跌倒，表示不舒服。练习向学校成人报告地点、发生的事，并请成人到场处理。
instructions.bm: Lakonkan rakan jatuh di padang dan berasa tidak selesa. Latih melaporkan lokasi serta kejadian kepada orang dewasa sekolah dan meminta bantuan.
instructions.en: Role-play a classmate falling in the playground and feeling unwell. Practise reporting location and events to a school adult and requesting help.

instructions.zh: 在学校平面图标出教师办公室或指定求助点，说明怎样找到帮助。不要对真人进行治疗演练。
instructions.bm: Tandakan pejabat guru atau tempat bantuan pada pelan sekolah dan jelaskan cara mendapatkan bantuan. Jangan merawat orang sebenar.
instructions.en: Mark the staff office or designated help point on a school plan and explain how to reach help. Do not practise treatment on a person.

successCriteria.zh: 求助时能说明地点、发生的事及需要成人到场。
successCriteria.bm: Ketika meminta bantuan, nyatakan lokasi, kejadian dan keperluan orang dewasa.
successCriteria.en: A help request states the location, what happened and the need for an adult.

successCriteria.zh: 能指出学校规定的求助渠道，不把角色演练当作治疗。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti saluran bantuan sekolah dan bezakan lakonan daripada rawatan.
successCriteria.en: Identify the school’s help procedure and distinguish role-play from treatment.

instructions.zh: 阅读这组原创虚构标签：A每份25克含糖3克；B每份50克含糖5克。先抄下份量及单位，再把两者换算为每100克的糖量。
instructions.bm: Baca label rekaan: A, 3 g gula setiap sajian 25 g; B, 5 g gula setiap sajian 50 g. Catat saiz dan unit lalu tukar kedua-duanya kepada gula setiap 100 g.
instructions.en: Read these fictional labels: A has 3 g sugar per 25 g serving; B has 5 g per 50 g serving. Record serving sizes and units, then convert both to sugar per 100 g.

instructions.zh: 说明为什么“每份3克少于5克”不能直接证明A每100克糖更少。再写一项仅凭糖量无法判断的营养信息。这是标签阅读，不是个人饮食建议。
instructions.bm: Jelaskan mengapa 3 g berbanding 5 g setiap sajian tidak membuktikan A lebih rendah setiap 100 g. Nyatakan satu maklumat pemakanan yang tidak dapat diputuskan daripada gula sahaja. Ini latihan label, bukan nasihat diet individu.
instructions.en: Explain why 3 g versus 5 g per serving does not prove A has less sugar per 100 g. Identify one nutritional question that sugar values alone cannot answer. This is label literacy, not individual dietary advice.

successCriteria.zh: 换算得A每100克12克糖，B每100克10克糖，并保留单位。
successCriteria.bm: Pengiraan memberikan A 12 g dan B 10 g gula setiap 100 g dengan unit.
successCriteria.en: The calculation gives A 12 g and B 10 g sugar per 100 g, with units.

successCriteria.zh: 比较使用相同基准，并承认一种营养素不能概括全部营养价值。
successCriteria.bm: Perbandingan menggunakan asas sama dan mengakui satu nutrien tidak merangkumi semua nilai pemakanan.
successCriteria.en: The comparison uses the same basis and recognises that one nutrient does not establish total nutritional value.

instructions.zh: 三人用软球进行轻轻滚传练习，先写好传球、接球、观察三个角色，每三次交换角色；共同约定开始和停止信号。
instructions.bm: Tiga orang berlatih menggolek bola lembut. Tetapkan penghantar, penerima dan pemerhati serta tukar setiap tiga percubaan; persetujui isyarat mula dan berhenti.
instructions.en: In a three-person gentle soft-ball rolling drill, assign sender, receiver and observer roles and rotate every three attempts; agree start and stop signals.

instructions.zh: 观察者记录轮换是否按约定进行。若有人想多做一次，演练怎样提出请求、协商并清楚通知所有人，再评价调整是否公平。
instructions.bm: Pemerhati merekod giliran. Jika seseorang mahu satu percubaan tambahan, lakonkan permintaan, perbincangan dan pemberitahuan kepada semua, kemudian nilai keadilannya.
instructions.en: The observer records the rotation. If someone wants an extra attempt, role-play a request, agreement and clear notice to everyone, then evaluate fairness.

successCriteria.zh: 三人均获得约定角色，轮换记录与实际次序一致。
successCriteria.bm: Semua mendapat peranan yang dipersetujui dan rekod sepadan dengan urutan sebenar.
successCriteria.en: All three receive the agreed roles and the record matches the actual order.

successCriteria.zh: 规则调整经过沟通和同意，能说明对其他人的影响。
successCriteria.bm: Perubahan dibincang dan dipersetujui serta kesannya kepada orang lain dijelaskan.
successCriteria.en: Changes are communicated and agreed, with their effect on others explained.

title.zh: 交通、游戏和生活器具的装饰艺术：制作与说明
title.bm: Seni ragam hias: hasil dan penjelasan

instructions.zh: 从教师提供的本地文化资料选两个本单元的实物实例，画出装饰特点，标明用途与来源；区分观察到的特征和自己的推测。
instructions.bm: Pilih dua contoh objek unit ini daripada sumber budaya tempatan yang disediakan guru; lakar hiasan, nyatakan fungsi dan sumber, serta bezakan pemerhatian daripada andaian.
instructions.en: Choose two objects from this unit in teacher-provided local cultural sources; sketch decorative features, identify use and source, and separate observation from inference.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 准确记录两个实物的用途与文化资料出处。
successCriteria.bm: Rekod kegunaan dan sumber budaya dua objek dengan tepat.
successCriteria.en: Accurately record the uses and cultural sources of both objects.

successCriteria.zh: 分开说明看见的装饰特征和仍需查证的意义。
successCriteria.bm: Bezakan ciri hiasan yang dilihat daripada makna yang perlu disemak.
successCriteria.en: Separate observed ornament from meanings that still require verification.

title.zh: 素描、绘画与版画：制作与说明
title.bm: Lukisan, catan dan cetakan: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Drawing, painting and printing: make and explain

instructions.zh: 以同一叶形为主题，比较铅笔画、水彩画和安全盖印的小样；说明三种方法的痕迹怎样不同。
instructions.bm: Bandingkan sampel lukisan pensel, catan air dan capan selamat bermotif daun yang sama; jelaskan perbezaan kesan.
instructions.en: Compare pencil drawing, watercolour painting and safe stamp-printing trials of the same leaf motif; explain how their marks differ.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 三个小样分别显示指定媒介或制作方式的痕迹。
successCriteria.bm: Tiga sampel menunjukkan kesan media atau kaedah yang ditetapkan.
successCriteria.en: The three trials show the marks or forms of the specified media or methods.

successCriteria.zh: 用小样中的具体位置说明平面或立体表现的差别。
successCriteria.bm: Gunakan bahagian khusus sampel untuk menerangkan perbezaan gambaran rata atau isi padu.
successCriteria.en: Use specific parts of the trials to explain differences in flat or volumetric representation.

title.zh: 景观、室内与工业设计：制作与说明
title.bm: Reka bentuk landskap, dalaman dan industri: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Landscape, interior and industrial design: make and explain

instructions.zh: 为阅读角画景观位置图、室内布置图和书架产品草图；在三图标出不同使用者需要与通行空间。
instructions.bm: Lakar pelan landskap sudut bacaan, susun atur dalaman dan rekaan rak; tandakan keperluan pengguna serta ruang laluan.
instructions.en: Sketch a reading-corner landscape plan, an interior layout and a shelf design; mark user needs and circulation space in each.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 三类设计分别标明使用目的和人的需要。
successCriteria.bm: Tiga rekaan menandakan tujuan penggunaan serta keperluan pengguna.
successCriteria.en: Each of the three designs identifies its use and user needs.

successCriteria.zh: 布局或产品尺寸安排与所述需要相符，通行路线可辨。
successCriteria.bm: Susun atur atau ukuran sesuai dengan keperluan dan laluan dapat dikenal pasti.
successCriteria.en: Layout or size choices match those needs and circulation routes are identifiable.

title.zh: 刺绣与陶艺：制作与说明
title.bm: Sulaman dan seramik: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Embroidery and ceramics: make and explain

instructions.zh: 看教师提供的刺绣与陶艺实例，分别画出一种针线纹样和一个器形设计，标出材料与工序。
instructions.bm: Teliti contoh sulaman dan seramik daripada guru; lakar satu motif jahitan dan satu bentuk bekas dengan bahan serta urutan proses.
instructions.en: Study teacher-provided embroidery and ceramic examples; sketch a stitched motif and a vessel, labelling materials and process order.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 根据实例区分编织、底布刺绣或陶土成形的结构。
successCriteria.bm: Bezakan struktur anyaman, jahitan pada kain dasar atau pembentukan tanah liat berdasarkan contoh.
successCriteria.en: Use the examples to distinguish interlacing, stitching on a ground or forming clay.

successCriteria.zh: 草图或小样标出的材料与工序符合所选方法。
successCriteria.bm: Bahan dan proses pada lakaran atau sampel sepadan dengan kaedah.
successCriteria.en: Materials and process labels in the sketch or sample fit the chosen method.

title.zh: 图形标志与摄影：制作与说明
title.bm: Simbol, logo dan seni foto: hasil dan penjelasan
title.en: Symbols, logos and photography: make and explain

instructions.zh: 为阅读社设计两个图形标志，缩印测试识别度；拍摄同一物件的两种构图，说明视觉讯息的变化。
instructions.bm: Reka dua logo kelab membaca dan uji pada saiz kecil; ambil dua komposisi foto objek yang sama dan jelaskan perubahan mesej.
instructions.en: Design two reading-club logos and test them at small size; photograph one object with two compositions and explain the changing message.

instructions.zh: 使用适合自己的安全材料；由教师安排需要工具的步骤。保留一张初稿和一项修改证据。
instructions.bm: Gunakan bahan selamat yang sesuai; guru mengurus langkah beralatan. Simpan lakaran dan bukti satu pindaan.
instructions.en: Use suitable safe materials, with tool steps arranged by the teacher. Retain a draft and evidence of one revision.

successCriteria.zh: 缩小或实际尺寸测试保留主要讯息的可辨认性。
successCriteria.bm: Ujian saiz kecil atau sebenar mengekalkan mesej yang dapat dikenal pasti.
successCriteria.en: The small-size or actual-size test preserves the recognisable message.

successCriteria.zh: 比较两张照片时，用画面内容说明取景改变的效果。

instructions.zh: 选教师已教的短歌，先标出换气处，再按稳定拍子唱一个乐句；录一次并指出一个可改进的位置。
instructions.bm: Pilih lagu pendek yang telah diajar, tandakan tempat nafas dan nyanyi satu frasa dengan detik stabil; rakam dan kenal pasti satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Use a short song already taught, mark breathing points and sing a phrase with a steady pulse; record it and identify one improvement.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 乐句按稳定拍子开始和结束，换气不割裂词语。
successCriteria.bm: Frasa bermula dan tamat dengan detik stabil; nafas tidak memutuskan perkataan.
successCriteria.en: The phrase begins and ends with a steady pulse, without breathing mid-word.

successCriteria.zh: 指出录音中一个具体时间位置及可改进之处。
successCriteria.bm: Kenal pasti satu masa dalam rakaman dan pembaikan yang diperlukan.
successCriteria.en: Identify a particular moment in the recording and a useful improvement.

instructions.zh: 按教师给的四拍图示，以拍手或打击乐器演奏两次，保留休止的时间，再与伙伴一起演奏。
instructions.bm: Mainkan corak ikon empat detik dua kali dengan tepukan atau perkusi, kekalkan masa rehat, kemudian main bersama rakan.
instructions.en: Perform a teacher-provided four-beat icon pattern twice by clapping or percussion, preserve rest time, then play with a partner.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 四拍总时值完整，休止时拍子不中断。
successCriteria.bm: Empat detik lengkap dan detik diteruskan semasa rehat.
successCriteria.en: All four beats are accounted for and the pulse continues through rests.

successCriteria.zh: 第二次与伙伴在约定的拍点进入和结束。
successCriteria.bm: Ulangan bersama rakan bermula dan tamat pada detik yang dipersetujui.
successCriteria.en: The partner repeat begins and ends on the agreed beats.

instructions.zh: 写一段四小节旋律或节奏，标清拍号及休止；演奏、录音并修改一小节，解释修改的效果。
instructions.bm: Tulis melodi atau irama empat bar dengan meter dan rehat; main, rakam dan pinda satu bar serta jelaskan kesannya.
instructions.en: Write a four-bar melody or rhythm with meter and rests; perform, record and revise one bar, explaining the effect.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 谱或图示与实际演奏的声音及休止一致。
successCriteria.bm: Skor atau ikon sepadan dengan bunyi serta rehat yang dimainkan.
successCriteria.en: The notation or icons match the performed sounds and rests.

successCriteria.zh: 说明修改了哪一处，以及声音怎样改变。
successCriteria.bm: Nyatakan bahagian yang dipinda dan kesan bunyinya.
successCriteria.en: Identify the revision and explain its audible effect.

instructions.zh: 聆听教师提供并标明文化来源的两段音乐。记录听到的音色、速度或力度差异，并说明一项判断的听觉依据。
instructions.bm: Dengar dua petikan dengan sumber budaya yang dikenal pasti oleh guru. Catat perbezaan warna ton, tempo atau dinamik dan beri bukti pendengaran.
instructions.en: Listen to two teacher-selected excerpts with identified cultural provenance. Note differences in timbre, tempo or dynamics and give audible evidence.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 两段音乐的来源标签记录准确。
successCriteria.bm: Label sumber kedua-dua petikan direkodkan dengan tepat.
successCriteria.en: Both excerpts’ source labels are recorded accurately.

successCriteria.zh: 用听到的音色、速度或力度证据支持比较。
successCriteria.bm: Gunakan bukti warna ton, tempo atau dinamik yang didengar.
successCriteria.en: Support the comparison with heard timbre, tempo or dynamic evidence.

instructions.zh: 小组安排一段短表演，分配歌唱、伴奏或动作角色，约定开始与结束信号；排练后检查是否协调。
instructions.bm: Rancang persembahan pendek dengan peranan nyanyian, iringan atau gerak serta isyarat mula/tamat; semak penyelarasan selepas latihan.
instructions.en: Plan a short performance with singing, accompaniment or movement roles and start/end cues; review coordination after rehearsal.

instructions.zh: 再次演奏或聆听，核对记录是否与声音一致，再说明一项改进。
instructions.bm: Main atau dengar semula, semak catatan dengan bunyi dan jelaskan satu pembaikan.
instructions.en: Perform or listen again, compare the record with the sound and explain one improvement.

successCriteria.zh: 角色和进入、结束信号有明确记录并得到使用。
successCriteria.bm: Peranan serta isyarat mula/tamat direkodkan dan digunakan.
successCriteria.en: Roles and start/end cues are recorded clearly and used.

successCriteria.zh: 排练后指出一次具体的协调问题及调整。
successCriteria.bm: Selepas latihan, kenal pasti satu isu penyelarasan dan pelarasan.
successCriteria.en: After rehearsal, identify a specific coordination problem and adjustment.

performanceTasks.title: Interpret a Malaysian climate graph
instructions: Use a cited monthly rainfall and temperature graph for a Malaysian station.
Identify the wettest month, calculate annual rainfall and describe temperature range; distinguish monthly pattern from one day’s weather.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Numerical values retain units and conclusions refer to the actual station and period.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Compare transport choices
instructions: Use maps of Japan’s high-speed rail and a major Asian seaport with cited sources.
Compare passenger versus freight needs, connectivity and one geographical constraint.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: The comparison explains the function of each network rather than ranking them from speed alone.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Trace an emissions chain
instructions: Draw an annotated chain from fossil-fuel use to increased greenhouse-gas concentration and warming.
Compare reducing electricity demand with changing to a lower-emission electricity source; identify one limit of each proposal.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Mechanism and mitigation are connected; weather variability is not used as a single-event proof.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Evaluate a school energy proposal
instructions: Compare roof shading, efficient lights and solar panels for a school; use a teacher-provided table of costs, energy savings and maintenance.
Choose a combination for a fixed budget and justify a trade-off.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: Uses all three criteria and distinguishes reduced demand from electricity generation.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: Study access to transport
instructions: At an approved safe observation point, record transport modes at fixed intervals without recording faces or registration numbers.
Tabulate counts, map access to stops and propose one improvement linked to observations.
Keep the labelled work and explain one conclusion to a teacher or peer.
successCriteria: A repeatable sampling method, map evidence and a stated time/location limitation.
The conclusion uses the supplied observations/data; unsupported claims are distinguished from evidence.
performanceTasks.assessment: Human-reviewed work; not automatically marked complete by MCQ scores.

performanceTasks.title: 绘制交通衔接图并解释选线
instructions: 使用注明日期和来源的马来西亚地区交通图，选择两个城镇和一个铁路站或港口；标出至少两条连接，并用图例区分道路、铁路或水路。
给定一个明确的出行或货运需求，标注起终点和换乘点，提出路线并解释地形、时间、成本或接驳条件中的两项限制。
把原图来源、草图及理由交给教师或同伴核对；注明示意图不能提供实时班次。
successCriteria: 节点名称、交通类型及连接关系与所用地图一致，图例清楚。
所选路线连续且符合需求；区分图上证据与需要另查的班次、价格、通行信息。

performanceTasks.title: Design printing-cost pseudocode and a flowchart

titleI18n.bm: Reka pseudokod dan carta alir kos cetakan
titleI18n.en: Design printing-cost pseudocode and a flowchart

materials.bm: Kertas berpetak, pensel, pembaris dan borang jejak di bawah; atau alat lukisan yang tersedia. Tiada rajah tersembunyi atau akaun berbayar diperlukan. Semua kadar ialah peraturan rekaan latihan.
materials.en: Squared paper, pencil, ruler and the trace form below, or an available drawing tool. No missing diagram or paid account is required. All prices are fictional exercise rules.

instructions: Input contract: (member, pages), where member is 0 or 1 and pages is an integer>=0. Cost in token units: member=1 gets the first 10 pages free and pays 2*(pages-10) when pages>10; member=0 pays 2*pages. Produce exactly one non-negative cost. Out-of-domain validation is outside this task.

Write your own pseudocode using INPUT, SET, OUTPUT and nested selection: test member first, then pages inside the member branch. Close every IF with END IF; every path must assign cost before one shared OUTPUT. Explain the inner condition’s purpose.

Draw your own complete flowchart: one Start and one End, parallelograms for input/output, rectangles for processes and two decision diamonds. Label every decision arrow Yes/No, including the non-member path and both pages outcomes. Show paths rejoining the shared output, with no dangling arrows.

Trace BOTH pseudocode and flowchart for these (member, pages)->cost tests: (1, 0)->0; (1, 9)->0; (1, 10)->0; (1, 11)->2; (0, 0)->0; (0, 10)->20; (0, 11)->22. Blank row per test: input__ | outer decision__ | inner decision/not executed__ | cost after processing__ | output__ | expected__ | match?__. Do not label an unexecuted inner test as false.

In a working copy, replace the paid-member formula 2*(pages-10) by 2*pages without changing any condition. Trace (member, pages)=(1, 11): the wrong cost 22 differs from expected 2. Explain why the 10 free pages were not subtracted. Restore the formula, rerun all 7 traces and retain both versions plus before/after tables.

Submit pseudocode, the fully connected flowchart, both sets of traces and repair notes. Explain why the inner pages test is skipped for one non-member case, and explain the cost at a boundary. Multiple-choice answers or an untraced drawing are not a complete submission.

bm: Spesifikasi input: (member, pages), member hanya 0 atau 1; pages integer>=0. Kos dalam unit token: member=1 mendapat 10 halaman pertama percuma dan membayar 2*(pages-10) bagi pages>10; member=0 membayar 2*pages. Hasilkan tepat satu output cost, tidak negatif. Pengesahan input di luar domain tidak diperlukan dalam tugasan ini.

Tulis pseudokod sendiri dengan INPUT, SET, OUTPUT dan pilihan bersarang: uji member dahulu, kemudian pages di dalam cabang ahli. Tutup setiap IF dengan END IF; semua laluan mesti menetapkan cost sebelum satu OUTPUT bersama. Jelaskan fungsi syarat dalaman.

Lukis carta alir lengkap sendiri: satu Mula dan satu Tamat, input/output berlambang selari, proses berlambang segi empat, dua keputusan berlambang berlian. Label semua anak panah keputusan Ya/Tidak, termasuk jalan bukan ahli dan kedua-dua keputusan pages. Tunjukkan aliran bergabung semula ke output yang sama; tiada anak panah terputus.

Jejak pseudokod DAN carta alir bagi ujian (member, pages)->cost berikut: (1, 0)->0; (1, 9)->0; (1, 10)->0; (1, 11)->2; (0, 0)->0; (0, 10)->20; (0, 11)->22. Jadual kosong bagi setiap ujian: input__ | keputusan luar__ | keputusan dalaman/tidak dijalankan__ | cost selepas proses__ | output__ | jangkaan__ | sepadan?__. Jangan tandakan keputusan dalaman sebagai palsu apabila ia tidak dijalankan.

Dalam salinan kerja, gantikan formula ahli berbayar 2*(pages-10) dengan 2*pages tanpa mengubah syarat. Jejak (member, pages)=(1, 11): kos salah 22 berbanding jangkaan 2. Terangkan mengapa 10 halaman percuma tidak ditolak. Pulihkan formula, semak semula semua 7 ujian dan simpan kedua-dua versi serta jadual sebelum/selepas.

Serahkan pseudokod, carta alir beranak panah lengkap, kedua-dua set jejak dan nota pembaikan. Pilih satu kes bukan ahli dan terangkan mengapa ujian pages dalaman dilangkau; pilih satu kes sempadan dan terangkan kosnya. Jawapan objektif atau carta tanpa jejak bukan hasil lengkap.

Flowchart is complete, with clear Yes/No arrows and every input path reaching output and End.
Seven tests are traced step by step on both artifacts, including decisions not executed.
Evidence shows the incorrect member cost 22 at 11 pages, repaired to 2, followed by rechecking every test.
