title.bm: Kajian kes: Tujuan Perniagaan dan Pemilikan Perniagaan

instructions.bm: Bandingkan milikan tunggal dan perkongsian untuk kedai kecil: modal, keputusan serta risiko liabiliti. Cadangkan bentuk berdasarkan alasan, bukan saiz sahaja.
instructions.en: Compare sole proprietorship and partnership for a small shop: capital, decisions and liability. Recommend with reasons.

successCriteria.bm: Milikan tunggal bergantung pada modal seorang pemilik dan membolehkan keputusan sendiri, tetapi sumber mungkin terhad.
successCriteria.en: A sole proprietor relies on one owner’s capital and makes decisions independently, but resources may be limited.

successCriteria.bm: Perkongsian biasa menggabungkan modal dan kemahiran; keputusan serta tanggungjawab perlu dipersetujui untuk mengurangkan konflik.
successCriteria.en: An ordinary partnership pools capital and skills; decisions and responsibilities need agreement to reduce conflict.

successCriteria.bm: Kedua-dua bentuk biasa mempunyai liabiliti tidak terhad. Jika dua rakan mahu berkongsi modal dan pengurusan, cadangkan perkongsian biasa dengan perjanjian jelas; ia tidak menghapuskan liabiliti peribadi.
successCriteria.en: Both ordinary forms have unlimited liability. If two friends want to share capital and management, recommend an ordinary partnership with a clear agreement; it does not remove personal liability.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Trend Semasa dalam Perniagaan

instructions.bm: Harga input meningkat 15% tetapi pelanggan sensitif harga. Nilai dua tindak balas selain menaikkan semua harga 15%, dengan satu ukuran kejayaan.
instructions.en: Input prices rise 15% and customers are price-sensitive. Evaluate two responses besides raising all prices 15%, with one success measure.

successCriteria.bm: Runding pembekal atau kurangkan pembaziran tanpa menjejaskan mutu.
successCriteria.en: Negotiate suppliers or reduce waste without harming quality.

successCriteria.bm: Uji saiz/pakej atau harga terpilih dengan komunikasi jelas; pertimbangkan kehilangan permintaan.
successCriteria.en: Test packages or selective pricing transparently; consider lost demand.

successCriteria.bm: Bandingkan margin sumbangan, volum dan aduan; jualan kasar sahaja tidak cukup.
successCriteria.en: Compare contribution margins, volume and complaints; gross sales alone are insufficient.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Penetapan Visi, Misi dan Objektif Perniagaan

instructions.bm: Tukar “kami mahu perkhidmatan lebih baik” kepada objektif boleh diukur. Tetapkan garis dasar, sasaran, tempoh dan cara mengelakkan ukuran yang mengelirukan.
instructions.en: Turn “we want better service” into a measurable objective, with baseline, target, timeframe and protection against misleading measurement.

successCriteria.bm: Contoh: kurangkan masa respons median dari 24 jam kepada 12 jam dalam 3 bulan.
successCriteria.en: Example: reduce median response time from 24 h to 12 h in 3 months.

successCriteria.bm: Rekod masa pertanyaan dan jawapan pertama menggunakan definisi konsisten.
successCriteria.en: Record enquiry and first-response times consistently.

successCriteria.bm: Pantau juga penyelesaian aduan atau kepuasan supaya respons cepat tidak menggantikan mutu.
successCriteria.en: Track resolution or satisfaction so speed does not replace quality.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Bahagian Fungsian Utama dalam Organisasi Perniagaan

instructions.bm: Rancang pelancaran botol boleh guna semula. Terangkan tugas pemasaran, operasi dan kewangan serta satu maklumat yang perlu dikongsi antara mereka.
instructions.en: Plan a reusable-bottle launch. Explain marketing, operations and finance roles, and information they must share.

successCriteria.bm: Pemasaran mengkaji pelanggan dan ramalan permintaan.
successCriteria.en: Marketing researches customers and forecasts demand.

successCriteria.bm: Operasi merancang bahan, kualiti, kapasiti dan penghantaran.
successCriteria.en: Operations plans materials, quality, capacity and delivery.

successCriteria.bm: Kewangan menilai bajet/aliran tunai; ramalan volum dan kos mesti dikongsi supaya pelan selaras.
successCriteria.en: Finance assesses budget/cash; share volumes and costs to align plans.

instructions.bm: Kedai mengalami pertukaran pekerja tinggi. Cadangkan tiga langkah HR dengan alasan dan data untuk menilai hasil.
instructions.en: A shop has high staff turnover. Suggest three HR measures with reasons and evaluation data.

successCriteria.bm: Semak beban kerja dan maklum balas pekerja keluar, kemudian baiki pembahagian tugas jika beban tidak seimbang.
successCriteria.en: Review workloads and exit feedback, then improve duty allocation if workloads are uneven.

successCriteria.bm: Sediakan latihan serta laluan perkembangan kerjaya untuk meningkatkan kemahiran dan peluang kemajuan.
successCriteria.en: Provide training and career-development paths to improve skills and advancement opportunities.

successCriteria.bm: Tetapkan ganjaran serta jadual yang adil untuk mengurangkan ketidakpuasan; bandingkan kadar keluar pekerja dan kepuasan sebelum serta selepas perubahan.
successCriteria.en: Set fair rewards and schedules to reduce dissatisfaction; compare turnover and satisfaction before and after changes.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Pengurusan Sumber Fizikal dan Teknologi

instructions.bm: Bandingkan membeli dan menyewa pencetak untuk perniagaan bermusim. Nyatakan dua kos/risiko dan satu cara menilai pilihan.
instructions.en: Compare buying and renting a printer for a seasonal business. Give two costs/risks and one evaluation method.

successCriteria.bm: Membeli memerlukan modal awal serta kos penyelenggaraan dan susut nilai.
successCriteria.en: Buying needs upfront capital, maintenance and depreciation.

successCriteria.bm: Menyewa mempunyai bayaran berkala dan syarat kontrak tetapi boleh mengurangkan modal awal.
successCriteria.en: Renting has recurring fees/contract terms but may reduce upfront capital.

successCriteria.bm: Bandingkan jumlah kos bagi tempoh dan volum sama, termasuk masa henti serta fleksibiliti.
successCriteria.en: Compare total cost over equal duration/volume, including downtime and flexibility.

instructions.bm: Perniagaan memerlukan RM 20 000 mesin dan RM 3 000 modal kerja bermusim. Cadangkan sumber berbeza serta dua perkara yang perlu disemak sebelum menerima pembiayaan.
instructions.en: A business needs RM 20,000 for machinery and RM 3,000 seasonal working capital. Suggest suitable sources and two checks before financing.

successCriteria.bm: Mesin RM 20 000: contoh pinjaman berjangka bank dengan tempoh sepadan hayat aset, jika aliran tunai mampu membayar ansuran.
successCriteria.en: RM 20,000 machinery: for example, a bank term loan matched to the asset’s life, if cash flow can meet repayments.

successCriteria.bm: Modal kerja bermusim RM 3 000: contoh overdraf jangka pendek dalam had dipersetujui, dibayar apabila hasil jualan dikutip.
successCriteria.en: RM 3,000 seasonal working capital: for example, a short-term overdraft within the agreed limit, repaid when sales receipts arrive.

successCriteria.bm: Bandingkan jumlah kos termasuk faedah dan fi; semak kemampuan pembayaran daripada bajet tunai serta syarat atau cagaran sebelum memilih.
successCriteria.en: Compare total cost including interest and fees; check repayment capacity from a cash budget and terms or collateral before choosing.

title.bm: Kajian kes: Penyata Kewangan dan Prestasi Kewangan

instructions.bm: Jualan RM 120 000, kos jualan RM 72 000, belanja operasi RM 30 000, aset semasa RM 40 000, liabiliti semasa RM 20 000. Hitung untung kasar, untung bersih dan nisbah semasa; nyatakan satu had analisis.
instructions.en: Sales RM 120,000, cost of sales RM 72,000, operating expenses RM 30,000, current assets RM 40,000, current liabilities RM 20,000. Calculate profits and current ratio, and one limitation.

successCriteria.bm: Untung kasar RM 48 000; untung bersih RM 18 000.
successCriteria.en: Gross profit RM 48,000; net profit RM 18,000.

successCriteria.bm: Nisbah semasa 2:1.
successCriteria.en: Current ratio 2:1.

successCriteria.bm: Nisbah sahaja tidak menunjukkan masa kutipan atau mutu inventori; banding tempoh dan konteks.
successCriteria.en: A ratio alone misses collection timing/inventory quality; compare periods and context.

instructions.bm: Anda mahu menjual perancang belajar. Rancang ujian kecil sebelum pengeluaran besar: pelanggan sasaran, bukti permintaan dan had risiko.
instructions.en: You want to sell study planners. Design a small pilot before mass production: target users, demand evidence and risk limits.

successCriteria.bm: Contoh sasaran: pelajar SPM yang mahu menyusun jadual ulang kaji; temu bual beberapa pelajar tentang masalah perancangan mereka.
successCriteria.en: Example target: SPM students organising revision schedules; interview several students about their planning problems.

successCriteria.bm: Uji prototaip dan harga, kemudian rekod pesanan sebenar dengan syarat jelas; bezakan komen berminat daripada pembelian.
successCriteria.en: Test prototypes and prices, then record genuine orders with clear terms; distinguish interested comments from purchases.

successCriteria.bm: Hadkan kos dan kuantiti kelompok pertama mengikut dana; teruskan jika pesanan, margin dan kepuasan menyokongnya, atau ubah reka bentuk jika bukti lemah.
successCriteria.en: Limit first-batch cost and quantity to available funds; continue if orders, margins and satisfaction support it, or revise the design if evidence is weak.

instructions.bm: Sediakan senarai persediaan kedai makanan kecil: pelanggan/lokasi, sumber operasi dan keperluan pematuhan. Jelaskan bagaimana bajet tunai membantu.
instructions.en: Prepare a small food-shop checklist: customers/location, operating resources and compliance. Explain how a cash budget helps.

successCriteria.bm: Kaji pelanggan, akses dan pesaing bagi anggaran permintaan.
successCriteria.en: Study customers, access and competition to estimate demand.

successCriteria.bm: Rancang peralatan, pembekal, pekerja dan modal kerja.
successCriteria.en: Plan equipment, suppliers, staffing and working capital.

successCriteria.bm: Semak pendaftaran/lesen dengan pihak berkuasa berkaitan; bajet tunai mengenal pasti masa kekurangan dana.
successCriteria.en: Check registration/licences with authorities; a cash budget identifies funding shortfalls over time.

instructions.bm: Rancang perniagaan dengan harga RM 30, kos berubah RM 18/unit, kos tetap RM 3 600/bulan dan kapasiti 400 unit. Hitung pulang modal, untung pada 400 unit dan satu risiko ramalan.
instructions.en: Plan a business with price RM 30, variable cost RM 18/unit, fixed cost RM 3,600/month and capacity 400 units. Find break-even, profit at 400 and a forecast risk.

successCriteria.bm: Sumbangan RM 12; pulang modal 3 600/12=300 unit.
successCriteria.en: Contribution RM 12; break-even 300 units.
Profit at 400 units is RM 1,200.

successCriteria.bm: Kapasiti bukan permintaan terjamin; uji pasaran dan sensitiviti volum/kos.
successCriteria.en: Capacity is not guaranteed demand; test market and volume/cost sensitivity.

followUpReview.scope: Rule-based checks of all active questions (templated maths, music and code answers recomputed; language, translation and distractor rules) plus reviewer reading by question family. Not a teacher-by-teacher certification of every question.

checks.browser: Round-2 follow-up (2026-10-01): 99 courses × practice/test = 198 browser runs completed with 0 page errors.
checks.semanticAndCurriculumAudit: Not complete; structural validity is not a factual answer or curriculum certification.

expansion.method: Original items written per grade and topic, checked by rule-based tests (languages, duplicates, give-aways, answer-length bias) and an independent item-by-item review of key, distractors and translations.
